name: agenting
description: Subagents let one session use several model tiers at once. This plugin makes that deliberate: a PreToolUse gate blocks any Workflow whose agent() calls have no model/effort, then, in manual mode, asks you to approve the routing plan, offering cheaper AND higher-quality directions (auto mode, the default, decides and lets it run). A finish check warns when a completed Workflow's journal shows agents that never returned. Per-project routing rules live in agenting/AGENTING.md; mode, disposition and a workflows opt-in persist per chat across compaction. Also a mid-session cache-cost tripwire, a tokenomics script, 20 tiered agent definitions and an end-to-end health check.
